title: Iron mace

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
The Iron mace is the third one-handed club and the last pure Blunt club until the Ashlands.
Its primary attack is a 3-hit attack combo with double damage on the last hit. Its slower secondary attack deals 2.5x damage and 2x staggering.
